run_metadata.coverage_summary: Degraded, SEARCH-ONLY run. The hard egress block seen on recent runs persists: the session network policy denies direct HTTPS to tender hosts. WebFetch to https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm returned DNS ENOTFOUND, and WebFetch to https://www.vendorpanel.com.au/publictenders.aspx likewise returned DNS ENOTFOUND, so no buyer-originated detail page, feed/API or tender document could be opened. Discovery was limited to WebSearch (US-indexed, lagging the 2026-11-19 run date, returning mostly cached snippets and third-party aggregator pages). Tier 1 swept by search (AusTender; NSW buy.nsw/eTendering; VIC Buying for Victoria; QLD QTenders->VendorPanel/supply.qld.gov.au; WA Tenders WA/Main Roads; SA Tenders SA; NT QTOL; ACT Tenders). Tier 2 swept by search (local government via VendorPanel and council sites incl. Brisbane; universities incl. Notre Dame, James Cook, Sydney; water corporations Sydney Water, Melbourne Water; electricity networks Endeavour Energy, Ausgrid, Transgrid). Tier 3 MANDATORY check done by search (SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery; BHP GCMS; Rio Tinto Ariba; EstimateOne construction subcontractor packages) - every corporate channel remained registration-gated or invitation-only with no publicly-visible open RFx; recorded as portals only, none fabricated. Net result: one genuinely NEW buyer-originated opportunity was surfaced and corroborated this run - DFAT-1113 PNG Health Program ENABLE Managing Contractor REOI/EOI (published ~5 Nov 2026, closing 1 Dec 2026 10:00am ACT), captured from DFAT's own business-notification and concept-note content plus a corroborating aggregator snapshot. The six opportunities carried from the 2026-11-18 run were re-checked: five were re-corroborated as still open (NSW ~$80M Master Media RFT closing 27 Nov re-confirmed by B&T 10 Nov; Brisbane Gardner Road Doc115483155 closing 7 Dec and Prebble St Bikeway Doc118000917 closing 11 Dec re-confirmed against the BCC current-tenders listing; TfNSW New England Hwy Maitland Westbound ROI 26.0000139291.0941.ROI publish 9 Nov closing 11 Dec re-confirmed) and the two Tenders ACT entries (SL20260630 closing 1 Dec, PIMA0014211 closing 3 Dec) were carried forward within their open window but were not independently re-corroborated this run. Three new source signals were surfaced and recorded (Endeavour Energy supplier/procurement channel via TenderLink + SAP Ariba Network; Sydney Water Current Tenders page; University of Notre Dame Australia procurement page). All seven tenders remain headline-only and UNVERIFIED on an opened buyer page. No opportunity, deliverable, date, value or contact was fabricated.
gaps: HARD EGRESS BLOCK (unchanged from recent runs): all direct HTTPS to tender hosts is denied by the session network policy. WebFetch to https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm and to https://www.vendorpanel.com.au/publictenders.aspx both returned DNS ENOTFOUND, so no buyer-originated detail page, feed/API or tender document could be opened. To restore full discovery these hosts should be allowed in the session network settings: www.tenders.gov.au, buy.nsw.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au, www.tenders.vic.gov.au, qtenders.hpw.qld.gov.au / supply.qld.gov.au, www.tenders.wa.gov.au, www.tenders.sa.gov.au, www.tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, www.tenders.act.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, service.ariba.com, gateway.icn.org.au, www.brisbane.qld.gov.au, www.sydneywater.com.au, www.melbournewater.com.au, www.endeavourenergy.com.au, estimateone.com, and individual council/university/utility/corporate sites.

Every tender captured this run is headline-only and UNVERIFIED on the buyer's own opened page. Titles, reference numbers and closing dates come from WebSearch snippets of DFAT's own pages, trade press, buyer-page snapshots and aggregators, not from an opened buyer detail page or an opened ATM. Deliverables, requirements, eligibility, evaluation criteria, submission mechanics, value and contacts are therefore mostly null and still need a detail pass once egress is restored.

DFAT-1113 PNG Health Program ENABLE: the reference, publish date (~5 Nov 2026) and close date (1 Dec 2026, 10:00am ACT) were surfaced via WebSearch of DFAT's own business-notification/concept-note pages and a DevelopmentAid aggregator snapshot used only as a discovery signal; the AusTender ATM itself could not be opened (egress block). Scope text is drawn from DFAT's public concept-note content read via search snippet, not from the opened ATM; evaluation criteria, documents, contacts and the exact submission mechanics still need confirmation on the buyer page.

WebSearch index lags the run date (2026-11-19) and is US-indexed. Almost all other surfaced notices had already closed (e.g. GovCMS DXP panel FIN-2026-27 closed 7 Oct; Melbourne Water ETP Sludge Dewatering EOI closed 1 Jun; numerous NT QTOL civil tenders closed early-mid Nov; multiple university RFTs closed earlier in 2026) and were correctly excluded, NOT captured. Genuinely recent (last 24-48h) buyer-originated notices are almost certainly undercounted.

The two Tenders ACT entries (SL20260630, PIMA0014211) are carried from the 2026-11-17/18 runs; they derive from an earlier WebSearch summary of the Tenders ACT open-tenders listing (which contained at least one garbled release/closing date), not an opened record, and were not independently re-corroborated this run. Both close dates and the PIMA0014211 procurement_type still need confirmation on the live portal once egress is restored.

Foreshadowed / early-stage items seen only in aggregator, portal-plan or news summaries and therefore NOT captured as tenders, pending release and verification on the buyer's own portal: Melbourne Water WTP Preliminary Treatment Stage 1 (invitation release estimated Q3/Q4 2026) and Melbourne Water Field Services Panel renewal RFT (to be hosted on Zycus, no date); Transgrid grid-forming battery tender (>1GW, foreshadowed for 2026, open/close not confirmed); Ausgrid community batteries offtake RFQ (status unconfirmed).

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery / SAP Business Network Discovery, BHP GCMS, Rio Tinto Ariba, EstimateOne subcontractor packages, and major retail/bank/telco e-sourcing hubs) remained registration-gated or invitation-only; no authenticated supplier session is available, so no corporate opportunity could be read. Recorded as portals only; no corporate tender fabricated. Management-consultancy / invitation-only RFPs are out of scope by definition and were not invented.

Five of the six carried opportunities were re-confirmed as still open via this run's searches (existing dedup_keys); they were not freshly discovered this run. Only DFAT-1113 is a genuinely new discovery this run.

Sydney Water - Current Tenders (https://www.sydneywater.com.au/about-us/our-suppliers/current-tenders.html): buyer-originated GBE current-tenders page; add to the water-corporation sample rotation alongside Melbourne Water (Zycus), SA Water and Water Corporation WA already recorded.

University of Notre Dame Australia - Procurement / Current Opportunities (https://www.notredame.edu.au/staff/support/finance/procurement/suppliers): buyer-originated university procurement page currently advertising an RFT (Managed SOC Services); add to the university sample rotation.

Once egress is restored, open the AusTender ATM for DFAT-1113 (PNG Health ENABLE) and the buyer detail pages for all re-asserted opportunities (buy.nsw NSW Master Media RFT; Brisbane Doc115483155 and Doc118000917; TfNSW 26.0000139291.0941.ROI; Tenders ACT SL20260630 and PIMA0014211), and complete the deliverables/requirements detail pass.

tenders.title: PNG Health Program - Enhanced National Advice, Bilateral partnership, and Learning and Evidence (ENABLE) - Managing Contractor
tenders.buyer: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT)
tenders.category: Managing contractor services - international development / health systems
tenders.description: DFAT Request for Expressions of Interest to appoint a Managing Contractor for the PNG Health Program 'ENABLE' (Enhanced National Advice, Bilateral partnership, and Learning and Evidence), a new Australian health investment in Papua New Guinea expected to commence in 2027 for an initial five-year term. The REOI stage is to establish a shortlist of capable organisations, which would then be invited to a subsequent request-for-tender stage.
tenders.deliverables_summary: Per DFAT's public concept note, the Managing Contractor would deliver selected national-level enabling functions and strategic partnerships that support Australia's broader health portfolio in PNG and integrated primary health care - aligning national policy, financing, evidence and partnership functions with Australia's health investments under the PNG-Australia Health Partnership Strategy, and supporting delivery of quality health services including disease-outbreak containment. (Drawn from DFAT's published concept note read via search; full deliverables to be confirmed on the opened ATM.)
tenders.scope_of_work: ENABLE is positioned as delivering national enabling functions (policy, financing, evidence/learning, and partnership/coordination) and strategic partnerships supporting the PNG-Australia Health Partnership Strategy and integrated primary health care, delivered through a managing contractor over an initial five-year term from 2027. Full scope to be confirmed from the ATM documents.
tenders.eligibility: Open REOI to establish a shortlist of capable organisations able to deliver the program (not verified on the opened ATM this run).
tenders.contract_term: Initial five-year term (program expected to commence 2027), per DFAT concept note
tenders.closing_time: 10:00 AM ACT time (per aggregator snapshot; not verified on ATM)
tenders.submission_method: Lodge via AusTender (not verified on the opened ATM this run)
tenders.reasoning: Newly surfaced this run (2026-11-19) via WebSearch of DFAT's own business-notification and concept-note pages (dfat.gov.au) for the PNG Health Program ENABLE managing-contractor procurement, with the reference DFAT-1113 and a 1 December 2026 closing date corroborated by a DevelopmentAid aggregator snapshot used only as a discovery signal. Buyer-originated Commonwealth channel (DFAT via AusTender); the AusTender ATM itself could not be opened due to the persistent egress block.
tenders.notes: HEADLINE-ONLY and UNVERIFIED on the opened ATM. Reference (DFAT-1113), publish (~5 Nov 2026) and close (1 Dec 2026, 10:00am ACT) come from DFAT's own pages plus an aggregator snapshot, not an opened AusTender record. Scope/deliverables text is from DFAT's public concept note read via search snippet; evaluation criteria, documents, value and contacts still null and need a detail pass once egress is restored.
